title: 内角掌扶与大点
description: 水粉画中，成人一手轻扶宽岩包，另一手稳握大点完成低位平衡。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: Create an original gouache illustration of a fictional adult balancing in a shallow indoor corner with one palm lightly on a broad volume and the other hand on a large jug. Both shoes press positive low footholds on the adjoining walls, and the torso stays upright over the supported legs. The palm acts as a gentle balance contact, without pushing into a strained split. Use a wide three-quarter view showing the whole opaque-clothed adult, both wall faces, and continuous thick crash mats. Paint matte mustard, lavender, and warm gray surfaces with visible brush marks. Keep anatomy and hand contact plausible. Exclude words, logos, leaps, dangerous height, or blocked landing.
